name: corelib-compare
description: Tools/perf/corelib_compare.py and its Jet twin corelib_compare/run.jet, matched Core workloads timed after compilation: base64 encoding through a standalone Rust program, Jet's Rust-backed Core API and a Jet source module, each built in a scratch directory under corelib-compare in the jet-dev state directory of ~/.cache, checked, sampled, and reported as JSON with each arm's median and its ratio to the Rust arm. HOME is the case directory's home/. The repository has no Tools/perf/package.jet, which the scratch package copies, so every run that gets past its arguments makes the scratch root, then exits 1 and leaves it empty. Cases: the defaults; every option, by prefix and with `=`; --help; a zero round count, a negative sample count, a word for a count, a missing value, an extra argument and a value for --require-win (each exit 2, no scratch root).
